title: Scope.
officialText: The provisions of this appendix shall regulate the division of the city of New York into geographical territories known as fire districts and control the occupancy groups and construction classes permitted in the fire districts. Wherever reference is made to the fire district, it shall be construed to mean the fire districts designated and referred to in this appendix.
